newsitem.title: CHILE: Soquimich offers land for copper exploration.
newsitem.headline: Soquimich offers land for copper exploration.

text.p: Chilean nitrate and iodine maker Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile SA, or Soquimich, will lease about 900,000 hectares of land in northern Chile this year for copper and gold prospecting, its general manager said.
Soquimich plans to lease the land probably in October and develop mining associations with metallic mining companies, general manager Patricio Contesse said.
"We're going to call for bids from the main mining companies operating in Chile in August and the awarding (of contracts) will probably be in October," he said.

Soquimich, the world's largest iodine maker and a top producer of fertilizer and lithium, will keep a further 400,000 hectares of land in northern Chile for itself to explore for metals independently.
The company expects to invest between $5 million and $6 million in exploration in the area, he said.
